typePromptPrefixes.dish: Dish sprite rule: one clean finished food sprite on a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma key background. The food silhouette must be complete and fully opaque. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation. Do not use #FF00FF anywhere in the food. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no table, no utensils, no plates unless the named dessert naturally requires a bowl, cup, dish, cone, or stick.
